annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BNB staking with a fixed daily return, directs viewers to external destinations, and invites them to join and make money immediately. The displayed Deposit control and BNB Harvest Daily ROI connect the offer to a solicitation to place BNB into the presented service. Audit-report and CertiK branding appear alongside the offer, but their authenticity, endorsement, and scope are not established, and one dashboard shows 3% instead of the separately advertised 5% return.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted participation is staking BNB, expressly linked to an asserted fixed 5% daily return; a dashboard also presents a staking and deposit interface.
